messages.text:
"A pixel art 2d game where you manage an ant farm, you can throw leaves(food) into the ant farm, make ants worship you and leave offerings(dead ants or food). And if an ant is unfaithful you can ask the ant priest to burn them on a stake or crush them with your fist. You can check any ant's hunger, thirst, health, and faith. Ants can make tunnel and special areas to store food, dead bodies, soldier barracks, or nursery. Also you can drop water into the ant farm too. Or you can just watch (2D Game, Phone/Tablet)
